definitions.explanation: Visiting someone who is suffering, hospitalized, or in difficult circumstances to offer comfort and encouragement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{慰問|いもん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To make a consolation visit to a hospital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{慰問|いもん}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: I participated in consolation activities for the disaster-stricken area.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{老人|ろうじん}ホーム→老人ホーム：28075_roujinhoomu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{慰問|いもん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}した→演奏する：20349_ensousuru⟧。
examples.english: A volunteer group visited a nursing home to perform music as a consolation visit.

notes:
Describes visiting people in difficult situations — the sick, elderly, disaster victims, or those separated from family — to provide comfort and encouragement. Often involves bringing gifts, performing entertainment, or simply spending time. Commonly done by volunteers, celebrities, politicians, and organizations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {慰問|いもん}⟦{公演|こうえん}→公演：11639_kouen⟧: consolation performance (entertainment for those in hardship)
- {慰問|いもん}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: consolation gifts; care packages
- {慰問|いもん}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: consolation/morale-boosting activities
- {慰問|いもん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧: to visit for consolation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見舞|みま}い→見舞い：03745_mimai⟧: visiting someone who is ill or in trouble — more personal and everyday
- ⟦{慰労|いろう}→慰労：25276_irou⟧: appreciation/consolation for hard work — thanking someone for their efforts rather than comforting in adversity
